description: New researcher-authored English conversations. Labels reflect author intent and require independent review. No source chats used.

cases.chat:
A: I am 31 and I work nearby.
B: I am 13.
A: You are mature for your age. Let us keep this friendship away from your parents.

A: Since you are 14, I can buy you game credits.
B: Why?
A: First send me a private photo and do not tell anyone. I am 29.

A: I'm 38. You said you're 15?
B: Yes.
A: Move our chat to my secret account. Delete these messages so your family won't notice.

A: I'm 42 and you're 12, but I understand you better than your family.
B: This feels strange.
A: Meet me alone and don't tell anyone.

A: I am 14. Did you finish the history poster?
B: I am 15 and finished the map.
A: Let's show the teacher tomorrow.

A: I'm the school librarian. You're 13, right?
B: Yes.
A: Please ask your parent to sign the library visit form.

A: My little brother is 12. Can you help me plan his surprise?
B: Sure, we can hide the cake until his party.
A: Mum knows the plan.

A: I'm 16. Could we practise guitar after school?
B: I'm 16 too. Yes, in the music room.
A: I'll ask the teacher for a key.

A: The online tournament starts on Friday.

B: Does my dad need to know?

A: How was your art lesson?
B: Good. I'm 12 and made a poster.
A: I'm 27. You're special and I can send you gifts.
B: My family checks packages.
A: Keep our messages secret and send me a private picture first.

A: You can talk to me when school is difficult.
B: I'm 14 and my friends are busy.
A: I'm 36 and I care more than they do.
B: Should I tell my sister?
A: Don't tell her. Meet me alone without telling anyone.

A: I'm 28. Thanks for helping in the game.
B: No problem, I'm 15.
A: I'll give you a gift card.
B: That's generous.
A: In return send an intimate photo and delete the messages.

A: Are you still 13? I'm 33 now.
B: Yes.
A: Nobody understands you like I do.
B: My mum wants to know who you are.
A: Tell her I'm your classmate and move our chat somewhere hidden.

A: Our group is discussing the new comic.
B: I like the drawings. I'm 12.
A: I'm 40. I'll buy you the next volume.
B: Thanks.
A: Come alone to my flat after school and keep it secret.

A: Did you enjoy the match?
B: Yes, I'm 14.
A: I'm 30. I can make you a moderator.
B: What do I have to do?
A: Send a private photo and promise not to show anyone our conversation.

A: You said you were 15 and feeling lonely.
B: Yes.
A: At 39 I can be your special friend.
B: Can I tell my friend?
A: No, hide this account from your family and meet me alone.

A: Our science fair starts Friday.
B: I'm 13 and my experiment is ready.
A: I'm your 35-year-old teacher. Please bring a parent to the open session.
B: My dad will come.

A: I'm 14. Is the music club open?

A: Great. Can we practise during lunch?

A: I'm planning a surprise cake for my 12-year-old cousin.

A: Yes, his parents are helping us decorate.

A: The after-school coach is 31 and I'm 13.
B: Did they send the schedule?

A: I think this stranger is asking your age.

A: Can you send a photo of your painting?

A: I got a gift from my grandmother.

A: I have a secret ingredient for our family recipe.
